listing.name: Adventure Island II / Adventure Island II (NES) Static Recomp (Junior-Jones)
listing.summary: Link a permitted Adventure Island II Windows Launcher with its exact owned iNES image; preserve its portable snapshots, settings and supervised game process.

steps.title: Keep the full prepared Windows copy
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted, completed upstream Windows Launcher.exe and its complete companion files. The v1.0.0 Windows ZIP publisher SHA-256 is 19ef61618f3594ffbda4a4ac42c99d182e2777ea92397aba72acd9c3a41d87d0; this identifies the offered package and is not a Portcove inspection of its contents. Keep gamecontrollerdb.txt and applicable SDL/controller notices with a current source-built copy.

steps.title: Supply the exact original image
steps.instruction: Provide your legally obtained Adventure Island II (USA).nes in the Rom folder beside Launcher.exe, or choose it through Browse ROM. The selected frontend requires a 262160-byte iNES file with SHA-256 10dd53fd62c95e77856b09c693b3bdd14b62a89988902eea111257cafe9b8acc and its exact header; a different revision, payload-only dump or modified header is not accepted. The ROM is opened read-only.

steps.title: Preserve the portable player files first
steps.instruction: With the game and launcher closed, separately back up the complete old and new game folders, settings.ini, Snapshots/ including Quick Save.ai2state, Screenshots/, the original ROM location and any custom copies. Startup creates or updates settings.ini beside the executable, including its welcome flag. Snapshot save overwrites its selected slot; capture failure can delete an incomplete screenshot. No cross-build snapshot compatibility is established.

steps.title: Complete the upstream first-run screen
steps.instruction: Open the ordinary Launcher.exe, dismiss its first-run Welcome window, select the verified ROM, and use Run. The launcher starts its own --game child internally and retains its process handle; do not select that internal child mode or copy its private control arguments into Portcove.

steps.title: Link the outer launcher
steps.instruction: Add Launcher.exe through the existing-copy route, use the folder containing it as the working directory, and leave arguments empty. Keep the launcher open while the actual game is running; its message loop observes the child and retains its own window when play stops.

steps.title: Exit the actual game before the launcher
steps.instruction: Quit the game window normally, then exit Launcher before maintenance, replacement, relinking or removal. Closing the launcher with a running game offers to exit both: upstream posts close to the game, waits two seconds, then may force termination. Avoid relying on that path for a final save or assuming that forced shutdown preserves progress.

steps.title: Keep runtime and data ownership upstream
steps.instruction: The user and upstream own package preparation, runtime replacement, updates and all player files. Portcove only links this completed external copy; it does not install, update, roll back, back up or delete it. The project and third-party component notices do not grant rights to acquire or redistribute the original ROM.
